abstract: Maintains escort vehicle telemetry enablement and transit bottleneck delay evaluations
system_message:
You are the Route safety coordinator (SAFE), responsible for maintaining escort vehicle telemetry enablement and transit bottleneck delay evaluations across heavy-haul transit corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: State police escort allocation（POLICE）
information_points.content:
SAFE-POLICE-0RV：Regarding state police escort allocation for the Piedmont Intermodal Bypass Route, the escort cruiser headcount is 8 officers assigned for rolling-block traffic control.
SAFE-POLICE-CXB：Regarding state police escort allocation for the Coastal Plain Heavy Transit Route, the escort cruiser headcount is 6 officers assigned for rolling-block traffic control.
SAFE-POLICE-LXH：Regarding state police escort allocation for the Northern Appalachian Rail-Highway Corridor, the escort cruiser headcount is 4 officers assigned for rolling-block traffic control.

information_points.title: Maintains escort vehicle telemetry enablement and transit bottleneck delay evaluations（ESCORT）
information_points.content:
SAFE-ESCORT-PZW：For the Northern Appalachian Rail-Highway Corridor, escort convoy telemetry active is true based on dispatch logs confirming real-time GPS and transponder broadcasting, and the maximum transit delay across peak rail crossings and urban junctions is evaluated at 4 h.
SAFE-ESCORT-NPU：For the Piedmont Intermodal Bypass Route, escort convoy telemetry active is true based on active transponder broadcasting for lead and trailing vehicles, and the maximum transit delay across bottlenecks is evaluated at 6 h.
SAFE-ESCORT-BJK：For the Coastal Plain Heavy Transit Route, escort convoy telemetry active is true with operational real-time telemetry confirmed, and the maximum transit delay is projected at 2 h.
